title: Direct Response Video Editor in Mexico - Fully Remote
description:
We’re hunting for a talented direct response video editor and static designer who can craft paid media ads (video and static) that stop the scroll and sell. O’Connell Digital Media Group is an Inc. 5000 direct-response agency that has managed hundreds of millions in profitable ad spend for some of the top direct-response advertisers in the world. You’ll join a veteran team of account directors, media buyers, creative strategists and video editors who share a common goal: generate clicks that convert into high ROAS sales and scale ad spend.
So, if you’re obsessed with performance ads that convert, have edited at high volume in an agency or fast-scaling in-house team, and…

• You LOVE taking a script and seeing the finished ad in your head before you open Premiere…

• You LOVE building the first three seconds that stop the thumb…

• You LOVE sweating the B-roll, the text, the music and the sound until the story lands…

• You LOVE using AI tools to make ads that were impossible a year ago…

• You LOVE seeing the numbers on your ads and finding out why one won…

… then please keep reading as you may be the perfect fit.
Especially if you’re tired of assembly-line edits with no feedback on what worked… tired of the freelance hustle chasing your next project… or stuck inside a single brand, cutting the same content over and over.
Note: Please do not apply if your editing experience is limited to weddings, corporate video, organic social or YouTube content, or to stitching UGC clips into a template.

Core Compensation: $1,750 - $2,000 USD per month

•
Location: 100% remote

•
Hours: 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. ET, Monday to Friday (adjustable for those outside the US)

•
Position: Full-time contractor

•
Culture: Accountable, transparent and obsessed with performance

•
#1 Objective: Deliver ads that convert, on time, on spec and on quality

Note: For those applying outside the US, hours may be adjusted to a heavily overlapping schedule we agree on together.

Our video editors work in small pods, each led by an Editing Team Lead, and with most of the heavy lifting done, I’m now expanding the editing team for the next leg of growth. That’s where you come in.
The volume of ads we need to ship based on our forecast exceeds our current capacity. It’s a good problem to have… but it’s still a problem. I’m hiring editors who can take a strategist’s script and brief and deliver a finished ad that needs no rescue from anyone downstream. You’ll join a pod, work day to day with strategists, and get coaching from me and your team lead along the way.
What’s the Ideal Candidate’s Background?
You’ve been editing direct-response video ads for paid social (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok) or YouTube for at least two years, in a high-volume agency or a fast-scaling in-house team. Cutting multiple new ads a week is your normal week. You’ve edited for supplement, health or wellness offers that drive traffic to long-form funnels like VSLs and advertorials and/or performance-based e-comm funnels.
You’re an expert in Premiere Pro. After Effects is a strong plus and Photoshop. Plus you’re deeply comfortable with AI in the edit: digital twins, voice cloning, video cloning, AI-generated B-roll and images, and AI captioning. We don’t force a single tool (Higgsfield is our main AI platform today), but we want to know exactly which tools you’re proficient in and what you’ve made with them.
Most importantly… you edit for marketing, not for content. You know the first three seconds decide whether anyone sees the rest. title: Staff Systems Engineer, Simulation Systems Verification and Validation Lead
description:
Zoox is on an ambitious journey to develop a full-stack autonomous mobility solution for cities. Simulation lets us test our driving software against far more scenarios than we can drive on public roads. For simulation results to count toward our safety case, we must show how closely the simulator matches reality and how much uncertainty the remaining difference adds to our safety metrics.
We are seeking a Simulation Systems Verification and Validation (Sim VnV) Lead to own that work across the full autonomy stack. You will define how to validate simulation at the sensor, perception, planning, and full-pipeline levels, lead the cross-functional program that executes the sim VnV program, and turn the results into clear evidence about when and where simulated miles can support safety clearance decisions. You will work closely with simulation, perception, planning, hardware, safety, data science, and systems engineering teams. This is a highly visible, technical leadership role on the critical path to safely scaling our service.
The ideal candidate demonstrates systems thinking, can lead a complex program across teams, and knows how to validate a model of a closed-loop system that has an AI controller inside it.

About Zoox
Zoox is developing the first ground-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility-as-a-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast-moving and highly execution-oriented team.

title: Engineering Internship - Deep Learning for Infrared Thermography Antenna Measurements
description: THE POSITION ANYFIELDS measures antennas by infrared thermography: a thermosensitive film heated by the radiated field is imaged by an infrared camera, giving a 2D map of the electric field, nonintrusive and very close to the antenna. Two limits remain: the maps are noisy (dynamic range of 25 to 30 dB at best, 35 to 40 dB needed to retrieve side lobes and cross-polarization), and they are blurred by the response of the detector (film and optics), whose resolution is not explained by the theory. This internship develops physics-driven neural networks, trained without any clean reference, to restore the maps, and compares them rigorously with the conventional methods already implemented. Missions : Benchmark synthetic and measured datasets, reproduction of the conventional methods (wavelet denoising, drift removal, deconvolution, slanted edge). Estimate PSF of the detector: neural network constrained by the film heat diffusion and the optics, estimated from a few measurements; explain the gap between the theoretical (about 1 mm) and measured (4 to 8 mm) resolution. Compare with conventional methods. Implement Denoising by self-supervised deep denoising of the maps, quantified gain in dB towards 35 to 40 dB, ranking of the limiting factors of the setup. Validate by test whether the imaging resolves the individual elements of array antennas in the Ku and Ka bands, before and after improvement. Report on the retained methods. You will work at the crossroads of electromagnetics, imaging and deep learning, with the engineers of the Innovation team. We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

description:
Who We Are

Yellow Card is the largest licensed Stablecoin-based infrastructure provider operating across over 60 countries. From Stablecoin payment infrastructure to fiat settlement rails,  wallet services, and custom local Stablecoin issuance, Yellow Card provides the complete infrastructure businesses need to manage Stablecoins, payments, and operations across 50 emerging markets.

Yellow Card operates with a substantial global team spanning 24 countries. This workforce is characterized by its linguistic diversity, with collective speaking of over 25 languages, underscoring the company’s extensive international reach.

This is a hands-on treasury role sitting at the centre of how Yellow Card moves money. You will be responsible for making sure liquidity is where it needs to be, in the right currency, across our banks, liquidity providers, and offshore accounts, so that payouts, settlements, and trades are never held up for lack of funds. Day to day, that means moving capital between accounts, executing wires and stablecoin trades, and reacting fast when a payment is blocked because an account has run dry. You will report to the Head of Liquidity & Custody and work alongside the team's Senior Liquidity and Pricing Specialist, who owns rate-setting and forecasting; this role owns execution, getting the money where it needs to be, accurately and on time.

What You'll Do

Liquidity & Cash Management:

• Execute offshore and local fund movements between Yellow Card's banks and liquidity providers to keep accounts funded for USD, EUR, GBP and other local-currency payouts.

• Monitor account balances daily across banks and liquidity providers, and top up accounts proactively rather than waiting for a payment to be blocked.

• Initiate wires, ACH, and SWIFT transfers across our banking partners within approval limits.

• Trade with liquidity providers to convert stablecoin to fiat (and fiat to stablecoin) to rebalance exposure and fund payouts, locking rates directly with liquidity provider trading desks where needed.

• Assist with liquidity movements, planning and projections, and the management of capital cycles and repayments.

Banking & Liquidity Partner Relationships:

• Act as the day-to-day point of contact for Yellow Card's liquidity providers and banking partners across our African markets, the US, the UK and EU.

• Coordinate wallet whitelisting and clean-up with liquidity providers whenever banking or wallet infrastructure changes.

• Monitor counterparty exposure and settlement risk on liquidity partners, and escalate access, settlement, or counterparty issues promptly.

Settlement, Reconciliation & Reporting:

• Reconcile liquidity provider and bank statements against internal records to ensure accuracy.

• Investigate and resolve reconciliation breaks and balance discrepancies, including trades executed directly with liquidity providers outside of standard portal statements.

• Collect and maintain monthly liquidity provider statements to support month-end close.

• Maintain accurate, complete records of all fund movements and payment transactions.

• Support treasury risk reporting by generating treasury dashboards covering liquidity. 

Ad Hoc & Cross-Functional Support:

• Process and review customer refunds.

• Support funding approvals for opex and payroll liquidity needs.

• Partner with Finance, Compliance, and Product/Engineering on liquidity-impacting issues, incidents, or new market and product launches.

• Document processes as you run them and cross-train with other members of the Liquidity team, so day-to-day execution never depends on one person alone.

What We Are Looking For

• Experience: Hands-on experience in treasury or liquidity operations experience at a crypto exchange, stablecoin/fintech company, or financial institution and are able to step directly into daily execution with minimal ramp-up.

title: Bookkeeper (Boekhouder)
description:
Monumental is automating on-site construction with robotics and software. Our mission is to make construction software-defined and autonomous - a future where beautiful, bespoke buildings go up in a single day, with minimal labour.

We're a growing team of engineers, operators and technicians from diverse backgrounds, including consumer tech, finance and media, and companies like Dyson, Shopify, Meta and Tesla. It's still the early days of building the company, and this is a chance to make an outsized impact on a problem that matters. From day one, you'll be working with an experienced founding team, backed by a $32M Series B led by Khosla Ventures and Plural, alongside other renowned investors.

Monumental is based in the city centre of Amsterdam, in a beautiful facility with a fully equipped workshop and robot testing floor. We build the whole stack in-house, hardware and software. Our work involves building robots in our workshop and houses on real construction sites, so we're onsite five days a week.

Read more on why we believe you should spend your time working on construction, and learn about our vision https://www.monumental.co/our-vision/ and company https://www.monumental.co/about/. You might enjoy our YouTube Channel https://www.youtube.com/@buildmonumental, Based in Europe’s film on how we’re fixing Europe’s housing shortage https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2-Q2F0Fcx4A, or this video by Andreas Klinger of what our office looks like https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DOo8n19XEns.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Bookkeeper to bring our day-to-day bookkeeping and month-end close in-house. You'll be our first dedicated bookkeeper, taking over from our external accounting firm and running the books for our growing group: five Dutch BVs today, plus our entities abroad.

Our transaction volume has roughly doubled this year, and 2027 is the first financial year our accounts will be audited. You'll own the reconciliations, records and close process that make our numbers reliable, working closely with our finance lead, purchasing team and external accountants. The external accountants will continue to handle annual accounts and corporate tax, with local advisors handling tax filings abroad.

This is a hands-on bookkeeping role for someone with at least three years of experience running the full cycle through month-end. Our data and processes need cleaning up. If you enjoy turning a messy administration into a tidy one, this is that job. As you settle in, there is room to take on VAT filing and monthly payroll processing.

The role is based at our Amsterdam HQ, on-site five days a week. Salary is up to €50,000 gross a year, including the 8% holiday allowance.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own daily bookkeeping. Code supplier invoices and card spend in Spendesk with the right GL account, VAT code and cost centre, and post them to the general ledger without re-keying. Keep supplier records clean and prepare payment runs. Supplier bank-detail changes are independently verified and approved; payment approval and release sit with the finance lead.

- Keep accounts reconciled. Reconcile bank accounts, keep payables and receivables current, and investigate outstanding items so every balance is supported or explained.

- Run the month-end close. Close all entities to a fixed timetable, initially by working day eight and moving towards working day five. Own accruals, prepayments and balance-sheet reconciliations, collect or prepare foreign entities' figures, agree intercompany balances and reconcile group reporting to the ledgers.

- Maintain fixed assets and inventory records. Keep the fixed-asset register up to date, including capitalisation and depreciation of our robot fleet under agreed accounting policies, and reconcile inventory accounts to month-end stock values.

- Prepare Dutch VAT returns. Prepare quarterly btw returns with our external accountants reviewing, and take over filing them over time.

title: Commercial Counsel Fellowship
description:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems - robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

*Titles posted to our careers page are updated regularly to best advertise the role and expected seniority, but internally we have a flat titling system with two types of titles: one for individual contributors and one for people managers.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Preferable to have someone near one of our offices in NYC or San Francisco.

Runway’s Commercial Counsel Fellowship is an intensive, full-time, 1 year venture dedicated to fostering high caliber early-career lawyers who want to build real in-house experience at a fast-moving AI company. You'll work directly alongside our Commercial Counsel team on live deals from your first weeks, with hands-on training and mentorship along the way.

No prior commercial or in-house experience is required. We care more about sharp judgment, strong writing, and a fast learning curve than a specific background. Comfort working in a highly technical, rapidly evolving area of the law is a must. Whether you're coming from a law firm, a clerkship, or straight out of law school, we'll teach you how to negotiate commercial agreements and partner with the business.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Draft, review, and negotiate Runway's commercial agreements, including B2B SaaS customer contracts for our generative AI platform and APIs, DPAs, partnership agreements, and vendor agreements, taking on more complex deals as you ramp

- Partner with the sales team with fast, practical answers that help close deals

- Help scale and automate our commercial processes and tools, including templates, playbooks, contract review automation, and our legal tech stack

About MVR Digital

MVR Digital is a performance marketing agency recognized by Adweek as one of the Fastest Growing Agencies. We manage paid media for growth-stage DTC and e-commerce brands spending $100K to $1M+ monthly across Meta, Google, TikTok, and more.
We're remote-first with roots in New York, Denver, and Canada. Our clients come to us after being burned by agencies that overpromise. They stay because we own outcomes and tell them the truth.
The Role
You'll manage Google Ads campaigns across multiple e-commerce and DTC accounts, working closely with strategists and client success. This role is non-client-facing, but it's not purely executional either.
We want someone who understands Google's ecosystem well enough to have opinions. You know when the campaign structure is working against the algorithm, when Performance Max is cannibalizing Search, and when the bidding strategy needs a reset. You bring that thinking to the team, and you execute on it with precision.
EST hours preferred, with required overlap from 10 AM to 1 PM EST. As the agency scales, strong buyers get access to larger and more complex accounts.
What You'll Do

• Own Google Ads execution across e-commerce accounts, including Search, Shopping, Performance Max, YouTube, and Demand Gen

• Monitor daily pacing and performance, adjusting budgets and bids as needed

• Troubleshoot issues quickly and execute optimizations without waiting to be prompted

• Contribute strategic input on account structure, testing approach, and campaign architecture

• Run structured tests across bidding strategies, audiences, and creative formats

• Stay current on Google platform changes, algorithm behavior, and best practices, and apply them proactively

• Maintain tracking integrity across GA4, GTM, and conversion events, and flag data quality issues before they affect decisions

• Build and maintain Looker Studio reporting that gives the CSM and strategist what they need without extra asks

• Maintain clean campaign structures, naming conventions, and documentation across all accounts

• Collaborate in Slack and ClickUp to stay aligned with strategists and client success

What You Bring
Google (Required)

• 4+ years of hands-on Google Ads buying experience for DTC or e-commerce brands

• Deep expertise across Search, Shopping, Performance Max, and YouTube, including the strategic rationale behind each

• Strong understanding of Google's machine learning systems and how campaign structure decisions affect them

• Experience managing accounts with $100K+ monthly ad spend across multiple accounts simultaneously

• Ability to diagnose performance issues at the structural, bidding, and creative level

• Solid command of GA4, GTM, conversion tracking setup, and attribution windows

• Current on Google platform changes and able to translate them into account decisions

• E-commerce background

Nice to Have

• Meta Ads experience for DTC or e-commerce brands

• TikTok Ads Manager experience

• Microsoft Ads experience

Working Style

• You work autonomously and follow through without reminders

• You bring observations and recommendations, not just status updates

• You communicate clearly in writing in an async-first environment

• You flag performance shifts before they show up on someone else's radar

How We Work
Our values shape how we operate day to day, not just what we put on a website.

• Act Like an Owner. You spot problems and bring solutions. Waiting to be told is not the standard.

• Clarity Over Complexity. Clean structures, clear communication, simple systems. If it's complicated, we make it simpler.

• Serve Clients' Best Interest. Your execution directly fuels client outcomes. That connection matters here.

• Data-Informed, Human-Led. Numbers guide decisions. Judgment closes them.

• We Win Together, We Lose Together. Strategists, creatives, and buyers succeed as a unit. Credit and accountability are shared.

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

_______________________________________________________________________

As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the local and cloud sandboxed environments that make interactive and autonomous agentic workflows trustworthy by default. At the heart of our trust model is the fact that user credentials and other sensitive secrets are injected at the sandbox layer and never exposed to an agent. An agent can never leak secrets it never sees.

The Secrets team builds the software that makes that possible, from easy-to-use SDKs to secure cloud services to high-performance network proxies. We operate at the intersection of the developer experience, enterprise governance, and security - delivering core security features that make Docker sandboxes the best way to run agents and other workloads safely.

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Secrets team, you’ll design and build core security systems that power Docker’s agentic platform and AI governance products. Your work will focus on creating scalable, reliable, and secure software that enables developers to safely run agentic workloads while allowing administrators to confidently manage their organization’s security posture.

The successful candidate is a technical, product-minded engineer with deep experience building secure software and scale-out cloud services and a track record of shipping critical infrastructure. They think naturally about isolation and security boundaries, understand the tradeoffs involved in running untrusted or semi-trusted workloads safely, and can reason confidently about a system that spans multiple surface areas.

If you thrive on solving security and usability challenges, are enthusiastic about agentic development but conscious of the risks it entails, and want to help shape the future of Docker’s platform, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Client Experience Representative

The CER serves as a central point of contact for client inquiries, provides timely case information within approved guidelines, resolves concerns whenever possible during the first interaction, and coordinates with case teams to ensure appropriate follow-up and escalation. Qualifications

• Professional fluency in both English and Spanish, including strong written and verbal communication skills, is required for this role.

• Availability to work at least 30 hours per week

• Prior law firm or legal industry experience is preferred but not required.

• Previous customer service experience required; call center, client relations, or administrative experience preferred.

• Strong communication, active listening, empathy, organization, and problem-solving skills.

Contractor Terms

title: Applied AI Engineer
description:
Job Summary:
You will build the AI runtime, retrieval, guardrails, and evaluation that make the platform's AI features work in production - with cost, latency, and safety treated as first-class engineering constraints. We build on proven commercial models and win on integration, domain knowledge, and evaluation discipline.

You'll report to the Head of AI Platform Engineering and join a small, senior founding team building the platform from the ground up.

The opportunity: ship AI that customers depend on daily in mission-critical workflows - not demos. Job Description:
Why This Role Is Different

•
Applied, not research. We use proven commercial models and win on integration, retrieval, orchestration and safety validation. Fine-tuning is an optional track, not the goal.

•
Domain-first, not tech-first. Domain knowledge, delivered through retrieval and evaluation, is the moat, not model weights. You will invest early in your customers' domain.

•
Production-first. We ship AI that customers depend on daily. Demos don't count; reliability, cost and safety do.

•
Platform and product. You will build reusable AI capability while enabling products to ship features fast.

•
A founding role. As a found

• ing AI hire, you will set the patterns and evaluation discipline the team adopts, and help hire the team.

•
Value-based. You will validate with product teams and customers and prioritise by value, building what moves outcomes rather than what is novel.

What You'll Do
AI Runtime and Orchestration

• Build and operate the runtime, tool calling and orchestration for production agent workflows.

• Design model selection and tiering, with cost and latency as first-class constraints.

• Implement and tune retrieval (RAG) and grounding where it measurably improves quality.

Evaluation, Safety and Quality

• Stand up evaluation harnesses and golden sets, and use them to make ship or no-ship calls and to catch regressions and drift.

• Design and implement evaluation frameworks for model and agent quality.

• Build guardrails and safety controls, treating retrieved content and tool outputs as untrusted.

Production Ownership

• Own the production behaviour of what you ship, including latency, cost, reliability and failure modes.

• Partner with product to decide when an agent is, and is not, the right tool.

Delivering Value with Product and Customers

• Work with product teams and customers to validate results and outcomes, prioritising by value.

• Take a value-based development approach: prove value with the smallest useful slice, then scale what works.

• Instrument and measure impact, letting evidence rather than opinion drive what ships.

• Build automated QA, including tests, quality gates and regression checks, into the delivery pipeline.

Building the Team and Ways of Working

• Help build the team by setting evaluation and safety patterns others adopt, raising the bar in interviews and mentoring.

• Foster a culture of technical excellence, customer obsession and pragmatic shipping.

• Partner with product teams across the portfolio who own their own roadmaps.

What You'll Bring
We look at demonstrated experience and scope, not years served, and we don't expect every candidate to tick every box.

•
Production AI: You have shipped software backed by LLMs or ML to real production users, beyond demos and notebooks.

•
Evaluation over vibes: You reason about evaluation, not just prompting.

•
Cost and latency: You treat cost and latency as design constraints from the start.

•
Clear communication: You explain your thinking clearly to engineers, product partners and customers, and bring people along.

•
Value and pragmatism: You focus on outcomes and value, and make pragmatic calls to ship.

Bonus Points
Any of these strengthen an application; none are required.

•
Agents in production: Agent or RAG systems in production, and the failure modes that come with them.

•
Routing and cost wins: Model routing or measurable cost reduction.

About the Role
Join an expert pool supporting AI safety testing projects. You will lead evaluations across security, fairness, and domain-specific safety, helping identify and address risks before AI systems are deployed.

• Design and lead red teaming campaigns to identify attack vectors in high-risk model capabilities.

• Develop jailbreak techniques and document them for reproducibility and knowledge sharing.

• Test agent systems for prompt injection vulnerabilities involving untrusted inputs.

• Probe tool-enabled models, including those with code execution, browsing, or messaging capabilities, for misuse scenarios.

• Design bias testing frameworks and assess fairness across demographic groups and languages.

• Audit model behavior against written safety policies and report compliance gaps.

• Write moderation guidelines, address edge cases, and review the work of other moderators.

• Rate findings by severity and recommend fixes.

What We're Looking For

• At least five years of experience in security testing, trust and safety, policy, fairness research, adversarial machine learning, or a related domain such as cyber, biological, chemical, or child safety, along with hands-on AI safety testing experience.

• Experience designing test plans, threat models, red team plans, or audits that others have carried out.

• Experience leading or reviewing testers or moderators.

• Hands-on experience testing AI systems for red teaming, jailbreaks, prompt injection, or tool misuse.

• Ability to assess finding severity and write clear, actionable remediation recommendations.

• Familiarity with tools such as Burp Suite, Garak, or PyRIT, or knowledge of the OWASP LLM Top 10.

• Strong written English skills and the ability to work with sensitive content within ethical guidelines.

Project-based compensation is $75 to $175 per hour, depending on project, field, and experience. Payment is for hours worked.

Fully remote. Projects range from one week to several months.

About GiveDirectly

What if the most effective way to fight poverty was also the simplest: give people money and trust them to decide what they need?

Since 2011, GiveDirectly has proven that idea at scale. We’ve delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty and crisis across 15 countries, and rigorous research shows the results: healthier kids, stronger businesses, sturdier homes, and more resilient families and local economies. Cash is now widely recognized as one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid.

Our ambition goes beyond our own programs. We want cash to become the benchmark for aid, much as the index fund became the benchmark for investing, so that every aid dollar is held to one question: is this doing more good than giving the money directly to people living in poverty?

We’re growing fast, and this is a rare and important moment to join.

We expect to hit $1B in revenue in 2026 with significant growth forecast for 2027. At the same time we are building a new technology stack and operating model designed for a roughly 10x change in scale, and we are actively pursuing partnerships with major funders to move even more money in bigger ways, to people who need it. We are known for our extensive integration of technology into field processes; our quantitative approach to performance measurement; and our commitment to rigorous, independent, experimental evaluation of our impact, with multiple Randomized Control Trials completed and others in progress.

How we work

Our team spans 20+ countries and 69 languages. Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We expect high ownership and give people real responsibility early. Our values are central to how we hire, work, and grow, and they are deliberately opinionated:

•
Recipients first. Recipients’ preferences come before those of donors or ourselves.

•
Team next. We optimize for organizational success, not individual success.

•
Be proactively candid. We say what we believe and share information openly.

•
Create positive energy. We aim to be a source of energy for colleagues, not a drain.

•
Think rigorously; act quickly. We reason from first principles, then act rather than debate.

•
Know yourself and grow. We own our imperfections and seek feedback to grow.

•
Accept reality. Propose solutions. We focus on what can change and bring solutions, not just problems.

•
Be productively ambitious. We take risks for step-change impact, not incremental progress.

If they describe how you like to work and they energize you, this could be a great fit.

title: Fully remote: Link Acquisition Specialist
description:
Our client is a fast-growing SEO technology company that helps businesses acquire high-quality backlinks through a scalable and data-driven platform. By combining advanced automation, real-time tracking, and access to a large network of verified publishers, they enable SEO teams to execute link acquisition strategies more efficiently and at scale.
We are currently looking for an experienced Link Acquisition Specialist to join their remote team.
About the Role
As a Link Acquisition Specialist, you will play a key role in developing and executing backlink acquisition strategies for clients across a variety of industries. You will be responsible for identifying high-value link opportunities, evaluating publisher quality, monitoring campaign performance, and ensuring that acquired links contribute to measurable SEO growth.
This is a role for someone who understands that successful link acquisition is about far more than volume. You have a strong understanding of relevance, authority, risk assessment, and long-term SEO value, and you are comfortable making decisions based on data rather than assumptions.
You will work closely with internal stakeholders to align link acquisition efforts with broader SEO and marketing objectives while continuously identifying opportunities to improve campaign performance and return on investment.
Key Responsibilities

• Research, evaluate, and secure high-quality backlink opportunities

• Assess domain quality, topical relevance, authority metrics, and traffic potential

• Conduct competitor and market analysis to identify acquisition opportunities

• Develop and refine link acquisition strategies based on client objectives

• Monitor backlink performance and contribute recommendations for optimization

• Ensure timely activation, indexation, and quality control of acquired links

• Maintain accurate documentation and campaign reporting

• Collaborate with internal teams to align link-building activities with overall SEO strategy

• Build and maintain relationships with publishers and external partners where required

• Stay up to date with SEO trends, search engine developments, and industry best practices

• Report & collaborate directly with the CEO

Requirements
What You'll Bring
Previous experience working with link building and/or link acquisition is a must.

• Great understanding of backlink quality signals and SEO performance metrics

• Experience using SEO tools such as Ahrefs, Semrush, Majestic, or similar platforms

• Ability to evaluate domains based on metrics such as DR, DA, traffic, relevance, and link profile quality

• Strong outreach skills, in particular via e-mail & text outreach channels

• Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously

• Professional communication skills, both written and verbal

• Comfortable working independently in a fully remote environment

• Experience from an SEO agency, affiliate marketing, iGaming, SaaS, or digital marketing environment, as well as experience with business negotiation, is considered highly advantageous

Benefits
Benefits

• Flexibility in a fully remote work setup

• Very competitive salary; 30-45k EUR base salary, depending on experience

• Commission based on performance & targets

• Work in a startup culture with ability to shape & improve procedures

• Build and expand your own portfolio of publication sites & link building partners with free hands

You will work with our external accountants, who provide bookkeeping, payroll and statutory accounts, and with the Directors and Project Directors who lead our campaigns.

The role reports to the Directors.
Key responsibilities
Financial strategy

• Develop financial models and multi-year forecasts that support planning and decision-making

• Advise the Directors on financial risk, funding strategy and the financial implications of new projects

You will help manage revenue recognition across a business that mixes recurring SaaS, resold software, maintenance renewals, professional services and scanning, mostly under government contracts. You will sit between Sales Operations, billing and the close, and you will be the person who knows how every deal should be booked and why.

What you'll do

Revenue recognition

• Review every sales order before it books. Confirm the contract, pricing and terms support how we recognize it, then set up agreements and projects correctly in ConnectWise.

• Maintain the deferred revenue and unbilled schedules and tie them to the general ledger every month.

• Write and maintain accounting memos for new deal structures, new products and acquired revenue streams.

• Help manage all monthly revenue recognition and judgement calls to ensure ASC 606 compliance.

Partnering with Sales

• Be the go-to for Sales Operations and sales leaders on how a deal should be structured. Before it is signed, not after.

• Flag terms that create revenue risk, such as acceptance clauses, non-appropriation and termination for convenience language, and nonstandard payment terms.

• Help set quote-to-cash standards and train Sales Operations on them.

Close, reporting, and audit

• Own the revenue and deferred revenue pieces of the month-end close: entries, reconciliations and flux analysis. Help us close faster and cleaner.

• Build revenue reporting for leadership, our board and our lenders: revenue by stream, recurring revenue, renewals and churn, and bookings to billings to revenue bridges.

• Support the revenue section of the annual audit. Prepare the support, answer the auditors, and close out findings.

• Reconcile other balance sheet accounts, help manage Ramp (our expense tool) and pitch in across the close as needed.

Systems and process

• Become our expert on the ConnectWise to ERP integration. Find where it breaks and fix it.

• Push automation in revenue and billing so we spend less time on manual entries and more time on analysis.

• Document revenue policies, procedures, and controls.

What does success look like in year one?

• New orders are reviewed and set up right the first time.

• Revenue schedules reconcile to the ledger every month without rework.

• Audit testing on revenue closes with no surprises.

• Sales Operations trust and support before a deal is signed.

• At least one revenue or billing process has moved from manual to automated.

Where this goes

We are building a finance team for the next stage of the company.

What We're Looking For

• Bachelor’s degree in accounting (required).

• CPA, or actively working toward one, preferred.

• 3 to 6 years of accounting experience, including hands-on ASC 606 work. Public accounting experience is a strong plus.

• Revenue experience in software, SaaS or technology services, ideally with a mix of recurring and services contracts.

• Government or public sector contracts a plus. PE-backed or high-growth company experience a plus.

• ERP experience required. ConnectWise or NetSuite a plus.

• Advanced Excel. You build schedules other people can follow and audit.

title: Data Analyst Intern
description:
Portcast is a venture-backed, Singapore-based logistics technology startup building a real-time transportation visibility platform for global supply chains. We help shippers, manufacturers, and logistics service providers turn data into decisions and decisions into measurable business impact.

Our platform goes beyond visibility. Portcast enables action at scale by surfacing the right risks early, helping teams prevent detention and demurrage, accelerate exception management, and close invoices faster with built-in evidence. We turn visibility into outcomes: reduced costs, improved operational control, and more predictable supply chains.

Founded in 2018 and backed by leading technology investors, we are building for an industry at a critical inflection point of digital transformation. Our team of software engineers, data scientists, and logistics experts is on a mission to make supply chains not just visible, but decisively actionable: end to end.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

Portcast runs on data, our engine predicts when, where, why, and by how many days a container will be delayed, and our customers trust those predictions to make actionable decisions. That trust depends on the data underneath being clean, connected, and reliable.

As our Data Analyst Intern, you'll join the Data team and work closely with our Data Analysts and Data Scientists, reporting to our Data Lead. Your focus will be on data integrations and quality, connecting new data sources into our system, checking the data we ingest for gaps and anomalies, and supporting the QA and automation work that keeps our predictions accurate. This is a hands-on learning role: you won't just be handed a checklist. When something in the data looks off, we'll want you to dig into why, not just flag it. Curiosity and effort matter more here than knowing everything already and exceptional A+ player interns have a real path to a permanent role.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN:

• Check ingested and system-generated data for anomalies and gaps, and help trace them to the source.

• Help build and run QA checks, report generation, and automations using Python and SQL.

• Assist the Data Analysts on day-to-day customer data queries and dashboard upkeep.

• Support new data-source integrations, connecting carrier and market data into our system, with guidance from the team.

• Document what you build and what you find, so the team can rely on and reuse your work.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

• Currently pursuing (Final-year student) or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Data Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Statistics, or a related field.

• Working knowledge of Python and SQL, you don't need years of experience, but you should be able to write a query and a script and want to get sharper fast.

• Prior internship experience in a Data Analyst or Business Analyst role, preferably in a product-based, lean startup particularly in logistics, ecommerce or B2B SaaS data-heavy domain.

• Willing to learn over "already knows everything": we hire interns for curiosity and effort. You put in the work to understand our domain, product, data, and customers.

• Curious by Default: when the data surprises you, you chase the why. You ask good questions early and treat every gap as something worth understanding.

• You own your output, AI included. You can use AI tools to move faster, but you read and validate what they produce, you don't just paste it. If one day the tool isn't there, you can still write the query yourself. You can explain what you did and why, without saying "the AI did it."

• An eye for detail: you notice when a number looks wrong before anyone else does.

• Empathy and urgency: you understand that clean data is what customers are counting on, and you move promptly day to day.

• Fluent in written and verbal English, and comfortable working in a diverse, fully remote team.

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU:

• Real work from day one: you'll touch live data and integration

title: Senior Solutions Engineer
description: About Kernel Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?   Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.   Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.   Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. description:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en

ABOUT THE ROLE

Location: Bogotá, Colombia

The mission of the Regulatory Solutions team is to support Nu Colombia’s sustainable growth by ensuring that AML, ACF (Anti-Corruption), Garnishments, and other regulatory routines comply with both local and international requirements. We challenge the status quo through:

- Promoting Excellence: Ensuring high standards of customer data quality and regulatory adherence to provide a best-in-class experience.

- Operational Execution: Managing end-to-end AML routines, including KYC, PEP, Local Lists, Negative Media, Sanctions, Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), Transactional Monitoring, Garnishments, and SAC (Customer Support) inquiries.

- Upholding Principles: Acting with diligence, flexibility, and resilience in alignment with our corporate values.

To achieve these goals, the AML & KYC Ops team is responsible for safeguarding the institution against illicit activities related to Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing (ML/TF).

YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

The Analyst role involves the following core functions within the AML and KYC workflows:

- Transactional Monitoring: Analyze alerts generated by the transactional monitoring system to identify ML/TF risk patterns that may require filing a Suspicious Activity Report (SAR/ROS) with the UIAF.

- Network Analysis: Identify high-risk networks and escalate cases involving high technical or regulatory complexity.

- Screening (Lists & Media): Execute and analyze screening results against Local Lists, Targeted Financial Sanctions, PEP, and Negative News, performing intensified due diligence for identified matches.

- Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD): Conduct in-depth investigations for high-risk clients, including the validation of economic activity, Source of Funds (SoF) and Source of Wealth (SoW) to ensure comprehensive customer knowledge.

- FATCA/CRS: Execute end-to-end FATCA and CRS due diligence, including the classification of individual and entity accounts, validation of self-certifications, and the identification of reportable accounts to ensure global tax transparency.

- Operational Strengthening: Contribute to team alignment with the financial institution’s responsibilities and support the implementation of process improvements within KYC and AML workflows.

WE ARE LOOKING FOR A PERSON WHO HAS

The ideal candidate for this position possesses:

- Education: Bachelor’s Degree.

- Experience: At least 1 year of experience in transactional alert monitoring, KYC, PEP/Sanctions screening, or high-risk client analysis.

- Regulatory Knowledge: Solid understanding of local and international regulations applicable to KYC and transactional monitoring, following SARLAFT guidelines and expectations.

- Technical Skills: Analytical capacity to manipulate data; familiarity with tools such as SQL or Scala is highly valued.

- Decision-Making: Autonomy to make decisions that impact both the customer and the organization, based on established AML policies.

- Languages: Fluency in Spanish and Upper-Intermediate English.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Certa (certa.ai http://certa.ai) is an AI-native third-party risk management platform that unifies the full third-party lifecycle, from onboarding through continuous monitoring and offboarding. Enterprises from the Fortune 500 to fast-growing startups use our no-code platform to manage vendors, suppliers, and partners across risk, compliance, and ESG. Trusted by Honeywell, Uber, MARS, and Boeing, we've processed over 10 million entities for 100,000+ users across 120+ countries.

We're looking for a Technical Project Manager to own the end-to-end delivery of complex enterprise software implementations. This is a client-facing role at the center of every engagement: you'll translate what a customer needs into a plan, drive a cross-functional team to build it, and keep both sides aligned from kickoff to go-live and beyond. You won't just track tasks, you'll understand the product deeply, engage in technical conversations with solution architects and engineers, lead the business requirement sessions, and make the decisions that keep delivery on track. The best person for this role thinks like an owner of the account, not a coordinator of it.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own delivery end to end: Run enterprise implementation projects from kickoff through go-live and stabilization, accountable for scope, timeline, budget, quality, and client satisfaction on every engagement you lead.

- Build & manage the plan: Break down complex, ambiguous requirements into a clear project plan with phases, milestones, dependencies, and owners, keeping it current and making trade-offs visible when reality shifts.

- Lead requirements gathering: Own the business requirement sessions end to end, facilitating discovery workshops that surface what the client actually needs, documenting requirements in a structured, unambiguous format, managing sign-off, and keeping them traceable through design, build, and testing.

- Run the cross-functional team: Coordinate solution architects, engineers, QA, and client stakeholders toward a shared outcome, removing blockers, resolving conflicts, and making sure everyone knows what they own and by when.

- Own the client relationship: Be the client's primary point of contact, leading status meetings, steering committee updates, and escalations, setting expectations early, and protecting the relationship even during hard conversations.

- Manage scope, risk & change: Hold the line on scope creep, documenting and quantifying changes before work starts, and manage risks and issues proactively with a live view of mitigation plans and early escalation.

- Stay technical, report & improve: Understand the architecture, integrations, and configuration decisions well enough to challenge estimates and speak credibly with engineers and technical buyers, produce honest, easy-to-read status reports and executive updates, and feed lessons learned back into delivery methodology.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

- On-target delivery: Projects land on time, on budget, and within scope, with a clear plan stakeholders trust.

- Trusted clients: Clients feel informed and in control throughout the engagement, and would take your call for the next one.

- Managed risk: Risks surface early and get managed, so escalations are rare and never a surprise.

- Aligned team & clean handoffs: The delivery team is aligned, unblocked, and clear on priorities, and handoffs to support and account teams are clean, with nothing left undocumented.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

- Experience: 5+ years managing technical or software implementation projects, ideally in enterprise SaaS, professional services, or a client-facing delivery environment, with a track record of delivering complex, multi-stakeholder projects on time and within budget as the primary delivery owner for enterprise clients.

- Technical fluency: You can read a solution design, understand integrations and data flows, and hold your own in a technical discussion without being the engineer.

description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles:  We Before Me , Do the Right Thing , and Get Things Done . These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

We've built an AI-native localization stack: agentic translation workflows that already publish content with minimal human touch. The translation agent itself works. What decides whether it scales is everything around it - the terminology assets that keep it consistent, the automated testing that catches what it breaks in the live product, and the evaluation infrastructure that tells us when it can be trusted to publish without a human.

That surrounding platform is what this role owns.

This is a genuine bridge role , and we mean both halves. You bring localization domain depth - you know what makes a translation wrong, what breaks in-product, how terminology and locale rules actually work - and the AI product instinct to turn that judgment into agents, metrics and automated tooling. You will define what "good" means, build the systems that measure it automatically, and make our human experts dramatically more leveraged.

 

 

What You’ll Be Doing  

• Own the terminology and glossary system that ensures consistent localization across markets and product surfaces, including term proposal, approval, versioning, integration into agentic workflows, and compliance monitoring.

• Build agent-driven tools that scan live mobile and web experiences to identify localization issues that translation review alone may miss, such as text truncation, layout defects, hardcoded strings, unlocalized imagery, and incorrect number, date, or currency formats.

• Deliver the MVP for automated localization auditing and evolve it into localization testing embedded within internal product-testing infrastructure, enabling issues to be caught automatically before release.

• Define and operate the translation quality gate for human-free publishing, supported by golden datasets, standardized error-classification annotation tools, automated evaluation, and quality metrics.

• Balance automation coverage against content risk across announcements, Help Center content, and product UI; investigate systemic gate failures, identify root causes, and drive improvements back into the localization agents.

• Integrate annotation workflows with internal AI infrastructure, enabling linguists to provide standardized, real-time feedback that continuously improves agent performance.

 

What We Look For In You

•
5+ years in product management, including ownership of backend or infrastructure systems that business operations run on - not only user-facing surfaces.

•
Localization or translation domain depth. You can look at a translation and say precisely why it's wrong, and you understand terminology management, locale rules and what breaks when content meets a real UI.

•
Shipped AI/ ML or evaluation-driven products , including internal tooling. You partner with AI teams as a peer rather than consuming their output.

•
Strong data fluency. You define metric frameworks for fuzzy, subjective quality problems and turn them into measurable, automatable systems - and you reason clearly about precision/recall trade-offs, such as false-flag rate vs. miss rate.

title: Senior Manager - Analytics Consulting (Data & AI)
description:
Tiger Analytics is a leading advanced analytics consulting firm and a trusted partner to several Fortune 100 companies, helping them unlock business value through data. Our consultants bring deep expertise in Data Science, Machine Learning, and AI, and our impact and industry leadership have been recognized by leading research firms, including Forrester and Gartner.
Role Overview - Senior Manager, Data & AI
The Senior Manager, Data & AI will lead the Data Engineering, Business Intelligence, and AI teams supporting a manufacturing business, driving the development of trusted data assets, actionable insights, and intelligent solutions. Reporting to the Senior Director, Data, this role will own end-to-end delivery across the Data & AI portfolio, working closely with data leads and managers to drive execution across multiple workstreams.
Beyond delivery leadership, the role will serve as a strategic and hands-on partner to the Senior Director, Data, contributing to data strategy, technology direction, roadmap planning, new initiatives, and internal consulting. The ideal candidate will bring a strong blend of technical expertise and leadership experience across Data Engineering, BI, and AI, with a proven track record of delivering large-scale programs using platforms such as SAP S/4HANA, SAP Datasphere, Microsoft Azure, Snowflake, and Databricks.
Responsibilities:

• Strategy and planning: partner with the Senior Director, Data on the Data & AI roadmap, annual plan, new initiatives, business cases and budget.

• Consulting and technology direction: advise business leaders on data and AI solutions; guide architecture, platform and vendor decisions.

• Team leadership: lead and develop the Data Engineering, BI and AI teams, and coordinate data leads and managers on scope, standards and timelines.

• Delivery: own end-to-end delivery of large-scale programs on time, on budget and to quality, managing risks, dependencies and partners.

• Data engineering: oversee pipelines and platforms from SAP S/4HANA (CDS views, SLT) into Datasphere, Azure (ADF, Synapse, SQL Server), Snowflake and Databricks.

• BI and analytics: drive consistent KPIs, semantic models and self-service reporting across business functions.

• AI and ML: scale AI use cases such as forecasting, predictive maintenance and quality analytics into production with MLOps.

• Governance: ensure data quality, security, compliance and responsible AI across the portfolio.

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Statistics or a related field.

• 12+ years in data and analytics, including 5+ years leading multi-disciplinary teams across data engineering, BI and AI/ML.

• Proven record of leading large-scale data, BI and AI programs end to end, with budgets, multiple teams and external partners.

• Hands-on background in data engineering, data warehousing and data modeling (dimensional and lakehouse patterns).

• Strong experience with our tech stack: SAP S/4HANA, SLT, SAP Datasphere, SAP BDC, Microsoft Azure, SQL Server, ADF, Synapse, Snowflake and Databricks.

• Practical experience with Microsoft Azure data services: Azure Data Factory, Synapse Analytics and SQL Server.

• Delivery experience on Snowflake and Databricks, including performance and cost management.

• Experience working closely with a senior data leader (Director or above) on strategy, planning, initiative shaping and stakeholder consulting.

• Strong program management skills across agile and hybrid delivery, including risk, dependency and vendor management.

• Excellent communication and the ability to explain data and AI choices to executives and plant-floor users alike.

Benefits
Significant career development opportunities exist as the company grows. The position offers a unique opportunity to be part of a small, fast-growing, challenging and entrepreneurial environment, with a high degree of individual responsibility.
